result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by degraded infrastructure, including cracked pavement and poorly maintained sidewalks. The absence of marked crosswalks, traffic control devices, and pedestrian signals at the visible intersection creates a high-risk environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Intersection
hazards.description: The intersection ahead lacks stop signs, traffic lights, or marked crosswalks, creating unpredictable vehicle-pedestrian conflicts.
hazards.location_in_image: Center background at the street junction

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk and Road Surface
hazards.description: Significant cracking and potholes in both the walkway and the roadway present tripping hazards and may cause vehicles to swerve unexpectedly.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and right side of the roadway

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A temporary canopy structure is erected directly on the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the existing sidewalk surfaces and ensure continuity across the dirt/gravel lot on the right.

result.summary: The environment is highly hostile to pedestrians, lacking any dedicated walkways, curbs, or safety infrastructure. The area consists of a degraded paved surface used for parking, forcing pedestrians to share space with vehicles without any physical separation or protection.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: There is no sidewalk or designated walking area, forcing pedestrians into the path of vehicles.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The paved surface is cracked and uneven, creating significant trip hazards.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and utility poles create blind spots that obscure pedestrians from drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Parked cars across the center of the image

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a raised, paved sidewalk to provide physical separation between pedestrians and motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Pavement Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the degraded pavement to eliminate trip hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale lighting to improve visibility and safety during low-light conditions.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is poor, featuring a narrow sidewalk on one side that is heavily obstructed by debris and trash. The opposite side lacks a formal walkway entirely, and the wide roadway has no lane markings, lighting, or traffic control measures.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Trash, bags, and debris completely block the narrow sidewalk on the right side of the street, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground along the brick building

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a paved sidewalk, leaving pedestrians to walk through an unorganized parking area.

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street lights are visible, which significantly reduces pedestrian safety and visibility during night hours.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Expansion and Clearing
interventions.description: Clear existing debris and widen the sidewalk to meet ADA standards (minimum 5 feet) to provide a safe, unobstructed path.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and personal security.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Construct a new sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a continuous pedestrian network.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is poor, featuring a narrow and degraded sidewalk that is significantly obstructed by a parked vehicle. There is a complete lack of safety infrastructure such as marked crossings, lighting, or traffic calming measures, forcing pedestrians to share space with vehicles on cracked pavement.

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstruction
hazards.description: A black SUV is parked partially on the narrow walkway, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, next to the brown building.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: The roadway and walkway surfaces are heavily cracked and uneven, creating significant trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and along the sidewalk area.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and widen the existing walkway to meet ADA standards and provide a smooth, continuous surface.

interventions.title: Parking Management
interventions.description: Install bollards or clear signage to prevent vehicles from encroaching on the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale lighting to improve visibility and safety during night hours.
